title: myrtus communis subsp. baetica
intro: Myrtus communis subsp. baetica, commonly known as Spanish myrtle, is a subspecies of evergreen shrub belonging to the Myrtaceae family. It is valued for its various health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in reducing stress, improving digestion, and fighting infections. The therapeutic actions of Spanish myrtle include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, which can help in soothing wounds, reducing fever, and protecting against oxidative damage. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, particularly myrtenal and linalool, which contribute to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities.
